The Mental Health (MH) Clinical Operations Manager (COM) is located in the Mental Health Service under the Behavioral Health Interdisciplinary Program (BHIP) Program Manager at VA Northern California Health Care System.

The COM works in close collaboration with the MH Management Team to facilitate the logistical and operational needs across MH programs at their site. The Chico COM directly supervises a workforce of BHIP employees at the Chico and Yuba City clinics.

The COM helps to ensure that the Behavioral Health Interdisciplinary Program BHIP Team meets the overall performance standards, measures, and mission of the VA and the BHIP Program.

The COM ensures timely, integrated, efficient and effective delivery of MH services across the continuum of care for Veterans who are served at the Chico and Yuba City sites.

Duties for the position may include but are not limited to: Ensures efficient delivery of services related to BHIP program, involving both day-to-day operations and long-term planning and growth; Provides oversight to BHIP team operations in order to assure comprehensive provision of collaborative care; Provides local operational oversight around utilization, bookability, and performance metrics, assures grid accuracy and maintains DSS mapping to meet programmatic expectations; Supervises BHIP multidisciplinary staff, which may include psychiatrists, psychologists, advanced practice nurses, social workers, peer specialists, and program support assistants; Hires and trains all BHIP staff at as assigned site; Establishes guidelines and performance expectations for staff, which are clearly communicated through the formal employee performance management system; Provides feedback and periodically evaluates employee performance throughout the year; Resolves informal complaints and grievances; develops work improvement plans, recommending personnel actions as necessary; Effects disciplinary measures as appropriate to the authority delegated in this area; Reviews and approves or disapproves leave requests; Establishes and monitors clinic profiles in terms of availability, utilization and scheduling, and staff productivity; Attends site management meetings and serves as a liaison with delegated authority as needed to address site specific operational concerns; Works with the facility management to maintain a clear understanding of policy and up to date procedures concerning local safety issues, disaster planning, and related preparedness concerns; Communicates with other MH Managers and MH Administrative Officer regarding any space needs or issues at a given site.

This includes acting as the MH POC and MH liaison, directing issues to and reporting back from the appropriate authority; Coordinates with and serves as MH liaison to Telehealth, BDMS, Clinical Informatics, IT and other services as needed in order to facilitate efficient clinical operations and address local problems across programs; Completes assigned Performance Improvement activities at the program, service line and medical center level; Coordinates with facility management to assure that engineering and physical plant concerns are addressed in a timely manner; Provides public relations and community outreach and education regarding VA care to various social agencies, medical/primary care, legal, housing, and welfare organizations; Participates in root cause analysis and addresses action plan items related to patient safety and patient care issues.

Provides specialized psychological services at all levels of complexity for patients, with service delivery to include intake evaluation, diagnostic assessments, psychotherapy and patient education; Assesses and diagnoses mental disorders and conducts specialized psychological and/or cognitive function assessments and neuropsychological screenings; Treats mental disorders through a variety of modalities (and especially EBPs), and provides adjunctive interventions for treatment of medical disorders; Provides a full range of therapeutic interventions including individual and group psychotherapy, family therapy, consultation, rehabilitation and psychoeducation; Participates on selection panels for Staff Psychologist position vacancies or other positions as assigned by Chief MHPL.

Other related duties as assigned. Work Schedule: Monday - Friday; 8:00 a.m. - 4:30 p.m.; Tour of duty subject to change to meet the needs of the Agency Telework: Available ad hoc as per agency policy Virtual: This is not a virtual position.

Du baust die Projektadministration von Grund auf auf, behältst Budgets und Fristen im Blick und sorgst dafür, dass alle relevanten Unterlagen vollständig sowie jederzeit nachvollziehbar vorliegen. Worum es dabei geht: Jedes Jahr stehen Zehntausende kleine und mittlere Unternehmen in Deutschland vor der Nachfolgefrage. Bleibt sie ungelöst, verschwinden Betriebe, Arbeitsplätze, Wissen und regionale Wertschöpfung. Wir wollen dazu beitragen, dieses Rückgrat der deutschen Wirtschaft zu erhalten und Betriebe mit verständlichen Informationsangeboten und praxisnahen Veranstaltungen dabei unterstützen, Unternehmensnachfolgen erfolgreich vorzubereiten und umzusetzen.

Degree: Successful completion of a full 4-year course of study in an accredited college or university leading to a bachelor's or higher degree that included 3 semester hours each in the following course areas: History of archeology; Archeology of a major geographical area such as North America or Africa; Regional archeology, archeological cultures, or sites in a specific part or portion of a major geographical area to acquire or develop a foundation for regional specialization for professional development; Theory and methods of archeology.

Methods include, but are not limited to, typology, classification, sampling, cultural evolution, diffusion, dating, and analytical techniques; Archeological field school, to provide a basic understanding of theoretical and practical approaches to research design implementation, field preservation techniques, and report preparation by participation in actual field work.

AND Six semester hours of related course work in: geography, geology, or cultural geography; history, historiography, or historical archeology; environmental studies; scientific writing (nonfiction English composition); and/or surveying. AND Archeological field school. Transcripts are required. -OR- B.

Combination of Education and Experience: College-level education or training that provided knowledge equivalent to that described in A above, plus appropriate technical experience or additional education. Transcripts are required. -OR- C.

Experience: Four years of archeological work experience that demonstrated a thorough knowledge of the fundamental principles and theories of professional archeology. The work experience must have included archeology field experience, which may include that gained in an archeological field school.

Field experience should have included a combination of professional experience in archeological survey, excavation, laboratory analysis, and preparation of written materials.

Applicants with such field experience should, after additional experience under the direction of a higher-grade archeologist, be able to demonstrate the ability to be a crew chief, directing the work of others at a single location as a part of a larger archeological project. -OR- Basic Requirements for the Landscape Architecture Series 0807: A.

Degree: Successful completion of a full 4-year course of study in an accredited college or university leading to a bachelor's or higher degree that included landscape architecture or landscape design.

Note: Successful completion of a 5-year program of study of at least 160 semester hours leading to a bachelor's degree in landscape architecture in an accredited college or university is qualifying for GS-7. Transcripts are required. -OR- B.

Combination of education and experience: for each year short of graduation, the applicant must have had 1 year of experience under professional leadership and guidance of such character and diversity as to be a satisfactory substitute for the required education. This experience must have included original landscape design.

Transcripts are required. -OR- Basic Requirements for the Architecture Series 0808: A.

Degree: Successful completion of a full 4-year course of study in an accredited college or university leading to a bachelor's or higher degree in architecture; or related field that included 60 semester hours of course work in architecture or related disciplines of which at least (1) 30 semester hours were in architectural design, and (2) 6semester hours were in each of the following: structural technology, properties of materials and methods of construction, and environmental control systems.

Transcripts are required. -OR- B.

Combination of education and experience: college-level education, training, and/or technical experience that furnished (1) a thorough knowledge of the arts and sciences underlying professional architecture, and (2) a good understanding, both theoretical and practical, of the architectural principles, methods, and techniques and their applications to the design and construction or improvement of buildings.

The adequacy of such background must be demonstrated by at least one of the following: 1.

Related Curriculum: Degree in architectural engineering may be accepted as satisfying in full the basic requirements, provided the completed course work in architectural engineering provided knowledge, skills, and abilities substantially equivalent to those provided in the courses specified in paragraph A.

The curriculum for a degree in either architecture or architectural engineering covers function, esthetics, site, structure, economics, mechanical-electrical, and other engineering problems related to the design and construction of buildings primarily (but not exclusively) intended to house human activities.

The courses required for a degree in architecture generally place emphasis upon planning, esthetics, and materials and methods of construction, while the courses for an architectural engineering degree place equal or greater weight on the technical engineering aspects such as structural systems, mechanical systems, and the properties of materials.

Because of this difference in emphasis, persons with degrees in architecture may have a preference for work assignments that offer greater opportunities for them to express their artistic and creative abilities.

As a result, they may be more concerned with planning and design aspects of architecture, and persons with degrees in architectural engineering may be more engaged in aspects emphasizing technical engineering considerations. 2.

Experience: An applicant lacking a degree in architecture must have had l year of experience in an architect's office or in architectural work for each year short of graduation from a program of study in architecture. In the absence of college courses, 5 years of such experience is required.

This experience must have demonstrated that the applicant has acquired a thorough knowledge of the fundamental principles and theories of professional architecture. -OR- *Additional Qualifications located under Education*

Schritt 1: Online Bewerbung
Reiche deine Bewerbungsunterlagen online über unser Jobportal ein. Damit wir deine Unterlagen weiterbearbeiten können, musst du ein Login erstellen. Nachdem du deine Bewerbung eingereicht hast, erhältst du eine Bestätigung. Wir beurteilen jede Bewerbung individuell anhand der Kriterien im Stelleninserat. Das braucht manchmal etwas Zeit. Wenn deine Bewerbung passt, kontaktieren wir dich für ein erstes Gespräch.
Schritt 2: Gespräche
Im Vorstellungsgespräch - telefonisch, vor Ort oder online - möchten wir dich kennenlernen. Wir überprüfen, ob deine Erwartungen an die Stelle mit unseren übereinstimmen, welche Erfahrungen und Fähigkeiten du mitbringst, ob dich unsere Kultur anspricht und wie du ins Team passt. Bei beidseitigem Interesse und je nach Stelle finden mehrere Gespräche statt. Alle deine Fragen zur Stelle, zum Team oder zu den Anstellungsbedingungen sind immer willkommen.
Schritt 3: Weitere Schritte im Prozess
Je nach Stelle vereinbaren wir einen Probe- oder Schnuppertag, stellen dir eine fachliche Aufgabe, organisieren ein Treffen mit dem Team oder laden zu einem Assessment ein. In der Regel gehören auch Referenzauskünfte zu unserem Bewerbungsablauf. Über alle Schritte im Prozess wirst du transparent informiert.
Schritt 4: Bewerbungsentscheid
Du bist von uns überzeugt und wir von dir? Nach einer mündlichen Zusage erhältst du eine Bestätigung, die Vertragsunterlagen und Informationen, wie es bis zum Stellenantritt weitergeht. Es hat nicht geklappt? Wir freuen uns, wenn du dich trotz Absage auf andere spannende Stellen bewirbst.

Vous possédez une première expérience comme chef de projet en direction de travaux ou conducteur de travaux en Suisse ? Rejoignez notre client et participez à des projets engagés dans la construction durable !
# **Chef de projet en direction de travaux** #
### A propos du rôle ###
Intégré à une équipe dynamique et très soudée, vous pilotez des projets de construction de la phase de faisabilité jusqu'à la direction de chantier. Vous agissez comme pivot central entre les aspects techniques, budgétaires et la coordination opérationnelle.
## Tâches ##
Ce poste combine analyse technique en phase d'étude et présence active sur le terrain pour superviser l'exécution des travaux et coordonner les différents corps de métiers.
* Valider techniquement et analyser la faisabilité des concepts en phase initiale
* Préparer, rédiger et assurer le suivi des appels d'offres
* Gérer le budget global et assurer le suivi financier des projets
* Coordonner l'ensemble des parties prenantes internes et externes
* Assurer la direction de chantier, le planning et le suivi d'avancement
* Piloter les entreprises sous-traitantes et garantir la qualité des ouvrages
* Veiller au strict respect des règles de sécurité sur les sites de construction
### Nous cherchons ###
* Une première expérience comme chef de projet ou en tant que conducteur de travaux avec la volonté d'évoluer.
* Maîtrise approfondie des normes SIA et des réglementations de sécurité suisses
* Grande rigueur organisationnelle et capacité à travailler de manière autonome
**Un atout si vous possédez**
* Maîtrise des logiciels CadWork ou Serli
* Diplôme d'ingénieur civil (HES, EPF ou équivalent)
**Pour réussir dans cette fonction, vos compétences personnelles sont les suivantes :**
* Leadership
* Diplomatie et gestion des conflits
* Autonomie et curiosité
* Organisation
## Notre processus de recrutement ##
Ce processus de recrutement est géré par Academic Work et notre client souhaite que toutes les questions concernant le poste soient adressées à Academic Work.
Notre processus de sélection est continu et l'annonce peut être clôturée avant la fin du processus de recrutement si nous sommes passés à la phase suivante. Le processus comprend des tests qui sont des outils permettant de trouver le bon talent pour le bon poste, de favoriser l'égalité, la diversité et un processus équitable.

The Implementation Manager, Technology & Vendor Integrations is responsible for leading the planning, execution, and operational deployment of strategic technology solutions and third-party vendor implementations across the Medicare Advantage health plan. This role ensures that technology platforms, vendor services, and operational capabilities are successfully integrated into the organization while meeting business objectives, regulatory requirements, timelines, and budget expectations.
The Implementation Manager serves as the primary liaison among internal business teams, IT, operations, compliance, clinical leadership, and external vendor partners. This position oversees implementation activities from business case approval through post-implementation stabilization and benefits realization.
Implementation Leadership
Lead end-to-end implementation of strategic technology solutions, vendor services, and enterprise initiatives.
Develop and manage implementation plans, project timelines, milestones, dependencies, and risk mitigation strategies.
Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure successful execution of implementation activities.
Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with business objectives.
Facilitate implementation governance meetings and provide status updates to executive leadership.
Vendor Integration Management
Manage onboarding and integration of new vendors supporting Medicare Advantage operations.
Serve as the primary point of contact between the health plan and external vendor partners.
Coordinate contract implementation activities, operational readiness, testing, and deployment.
Oversee vendor performance during implementation and stabilization periods.
Escalate and resolve implementation issues, risks, and barriers impacting delivery.
Technology Deployment & Integration
Partner with IT and architecture teams to ensure technical integration requirements are defined and executed.
Oversee system testing, user acceptance testing (UAT), defect remediation, and production readiness activities.
Ensure integration with upstream and downstream systems is validated and documented.
Operational Readiness
Develop operational readiness plans to support successful implementation and adoption.
Coordinate business process design, workflow development, training, and communication activities.
Ensure policies, procedures, and job aids are updated to support new capabilities.
Conduct readiness assessments and go-live reviews before deployment.
Support stabilization activities and transition solutions into ongoing operations.
Regulatory & Compliance Support
Ensure implementations support Medicare Advantage regulatory requirements and organizational compliance standards.
Collaborate with Compliance, Legal, Privacy, and Information Security teams throughout implementation lifecycles.
Verify appropriate controls, documentation, and operational processes are in place before launch.
Support audit readiness and implementation documentation requirements.
Stakeholder Management
Build strong relationships with business leaders and executive sponsors.
Facilitate cross-functional workshops and implementation planning sessions.
Manage stakeholder expectations and communicate project progress, risks, and decisions.
Drive alignment across business, operational, technical, and vendor teams.
Performance & Continuous Improvement
Track implementation performance metrics and post-launch outcomes.

This position is located in the Division of Executive Resources (DER), within the Office of Human Resources (OHR), OASAM. The Division is responsible for developing policies and providing human resource services and operational support for the members of the Senior Executive Service (SES) and non-career staff.

Major duties include but are not limited to the following: Plan, design, develop, deliver, evaluate, and update technical training programs and curricula for Department-wide executive development across all Department of Labor (DOL) agencies to ensure enterprise learning quality, relevance, and mission alignment.

Develop Department-wide policy, procedural guidance, SOPs, and instructions for executive resources and executive development programs to standardize practices and ensure compliance across the enterprise.

Conduct complex analyses and special studies (quantitative/qualitative) on DOL training effectiveness, and program trends to diagnose issues and produce evidence-based recommendations for senior leadership.

Lead SME workgroups and serve as the authoritative subject matter expert to create, evaluate, and revise enterprise training content and tools to maintain technical accuracy, consistency, and alignment with DOL policy.

Advise senior leadership and serve as principal liaison across DOL and program offices to identify operational needs, strengthen performance, and guide executive development priorities and resource approaches.

At the GS-13 level, the incumbent performs similar duties; however, responsibilities are less complex and work is performed with greater guidance from the supervisor or other specialists.
For GS-14: Applicants must have 52 weeks of specialized experience equivalent to at least the next lower grade level, GS-13, in the Federal Service. For GS-13: Applicants must have 52 weeks of specialized experience equivalent to at least the next lower grade level, GS-12, in the Federal Service.

Specialized Experience is the experience that equipped the applicant with the particular knowledge, skills, and abilities (KSA's) to perform the duties of the position successfully, and that is typically in or related to the position to be filled.

To be creditable, specialized experience must have been equivalent to at least the next lower grade level.

To qualify for this GS-201-13, applicants must meet 3 of the following examples of specialized experience: Experience assisting in development and delivery of executive development training content for executives and managers to support Department-wide executive learning objectives and capability-building efforts.

Experience supporting SES career development, talent management, and executive development processes by gathering data, drafting materials, and coordinating actions to ensure accurate documentation, consistent implementation, and smooth program operations.

Experience conducting routine training needs assessments, data reviews, and evaluation activities for executive development programs to identify capability gaps, summarize findings, and support program enhancement recommendations.

Experience coordinating communications, logistics, and materials for executive development activities for department-wide training events to ensure timely preparation, effective delivery, and successful participant engagement.

To qualify for this GS-201-14, applicants must meet all of the following examples of specialized experience: Experience managing and leading Department-wide executive training and development programs for SES and senior-level staff to plan, design, deliver, and evaluate technical training that advances enterprise workforce capability.

Experience developing agency-wide policy, SOPs, and guidance for executive development to standardize practice and ensure compliance.

Experience conducting program analyses and leading subject matter expert (SME) workgroups on enterprise training content and evaluation tools to maintain technical accuracy, consistency, and continuous improvement of executive development offerings.

Project Manager, Client Onboarding
CrelioHealth Inc. · Remote (United States) · Full-time · Travel to client sites (~25–40%)
Compensation: $95,000 – $120,000 base, depending on experience + performance incentives (including incentives on expansion or referral opportunities you help close). Benefits include health coverage and PTO.
About CrelioHealth
CrelioHealth builds cloud-based laboratory information systems (LIS/LIMS) that power diagnostic labs across the United States and 2,500+ labs worldwide. Our platform runs the full lab workflow — from order booking and specimen tracking through result reporting, patient engagement, billing, and inventory — for physician office labs, hospital labs, reference labs, and direct-to-consumer testing companies. We are HIPAA-compliant, SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certified, and growing quickly in the US market.

When a lab signs with CrelioHealth , you are the person who turns that signature into a running lab. You will own client onboarding end to end: planning the implementation, configuring the rollout with our product and support teams, training lab staff, managing the go-live, and making sure the client is delighted enough to expand and refer. You are the face of CrelioHealth from kickoff to steady state.
This is not a sales role. You carry no quota and you will never cold-call. But onboarding is where trust is built, and trust is where growth comes from. We want someone who can confidently present the platform, handle a skeptical lab director, and spot the moment a client is ready for another module or another location — and who earns incentives when those opportunities convert.

Lead onboarding projects for new US clients — single-site labs through multi-location networks — from kickoff through go-live and handover to support.
Build and run the implementation plan: scope, milestones, data migration, instrument interfaces, integrations (EHR/EMR, billing, HL7/FHIR), user setup, and validation.
Coordinate internal teams (product, engineering, support) and client stakeholders (lab directors, pathologists, techs, front-desk, billing, IT) to keep every go-live on schedule.
Travel to client sites for kickoffs, go-lives, and training — roughly 25–40% of your time, varying with the project calendar.
Make clients successful
Train lab staff on real workflows — accessioning, worklists, QC, reporting, patient portal — and adapt the training to how each lab actually operates.
Anticipate and manage change resistance: a lab switching its LIS is changing how everyone works, and you will guide them through it.
Track onboarding health (time-to-go-live, adoption, early ticket volume) and report status honestly to clients and leadership.
Champion the platform
Present and demo CrelioHealth confidently — to the client team that signed, and to the wider staff who did not choose it but must love it.
Identify expansion opportunities during onboarding (additional modules, locations, or referrals) and hand them to the growth team — with incentives for you when they close.
Feed what you learn on the ground back into product and our onboarding playbook, which you will help write.

4–7 years of project management experience , with at least 2 years implementing or onboarding software for external clients.
Healthcare experience is required ; hands-on time in a clinical laboratory or laboratory environment is strongly preferred — as a lab tech, lab manager, LIS analyst, or implementer of lab systems (LIS/LIMS, EHR, RCM).
Fluency with lab operations concepts: specimen lifecycle, accessioning, QC/QA, instrument interfacing, CLIA/CAP context, HIPAA, and result reporting.
Excellent presenter and communicator — comfortable running a room of skeptical clinicians, and equally comfortable on a video call with a solo lab owner.
Structured and self-managing: you can run multiple concurrent onboardings remotely without anyone chasing you.
Willingness to travel to client sites across the US; valid driver’s license and authorization to work in the United States.
Nice-to-haves
Direct experience with an LIS/LIMS migration or go-live (any vendor).
Familiarity with HL7v2 / FHIR interfaces, lab billing/RCM basics, or instrument middleware.
Experience in customer success, solutions consulting, or pre-sales — anywhere you have had to win people over, not just manage tasks.
PMP, CAPM, or Lean Six Sigma is welcome but not required — we care more about go-lives you have shipped than certificates you hold.
Comfort using modern AI tools to work faster (drafting plans, summarizing calls, preparing training material) — with the judgment to know what still needs a human.
How We Hire
We know polished resumes and cover letters are easy to generate these days, so our process is built around watching you work rather than reading about it. After a screening call, you will do a live onboarding simulation based on a realistic lab scenario, and a short role-play where you present CrelioHealth to a (friendly but skeptical) “lab director.” No trick questions, no take-home busywork — just the actual job, compressed. We will respect your time and give you a decision quickly.
The Fine Print
CrelioHealth Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.
The salary range above is a good-faith estimate for this posting and may vary based on experience, skills, and location within the US.

At Zurich, our ambition is to put customers at the heart of everything we do and become the insurer of choice by building meaningful relationships that earn customer loyalty over time.
Over the past several years, we have made significant progress in building customer thinking into our strategy, products, services and ways of working. However, there is still more to do to ensure customer perspectives consistently shape decisions across the organisation and become embedded in our everyday mindset and culture. We believe better customer understanding leads to better business decisions.
The Group Customer Office plays a central role in this transformation, partnering with markets and functions around the world to ensure the voice of the customer is heard, understood and acted upon. Through customer, market and brand insights, we help the business better understand changing customer needs, identify opportunities for improvement and make decisions that strengthen customer loyalty, drive growth and create long-term value.
To support this effort, we are looking for a passionate, curious and commercially minded insights professional to join our Customer, Market & Brand Insights team. This role is paramount in translating our data and research into actionable insights that influence business decisions and drive meaningful change.
Working closely with markets, regional stakeholders and senior leaders, you will help evolve and deliver our global brand and experience insights tracking tools to deliver value to the business, ensuring customer understanding influences business decisions and actions.
As we continue to embrace AI and new analytical capabilities, we are also transforming how insight is generated and activated, allowing us to spend less time producing reports and more time influencing decisions and delivering impact.
Reporting to the Head of Global Brand Tracking & NPS, this role will focus on understanding how our brand health created through our products, services and experiences shapes customer perceptions and behaviours, and ensuring those insights are translated into actions that improve customer outcomes and business performance.

s.h: As Senior Insight Manager you will
s.t:
* Champion the voice of the customer, helping embed customer thinking into decision-making across Zurich.
* Generate compelling customer and brand insights that influence to drive business impact
* Oversee Zurich's global retail Brand and Relationship NPS programmes and lead our Commercial Broker study, ensuring high-quality delivery, governance and business value.
* Evolve our insight programmes and measurement approaches to ensure they remain relevant to changing customer and business needs.
* Transform complex data into clear, actionable recommendations and executive-level narratives that drive action.
* Partner with the insights team, markets, agencies and business stakeholders to identify opportunities, solve business challenges and accelerate customer-centred change.
* Connect customer, brand and business data to strengthen understanding of performance drivers and commercial impact.
* Facilitate discussions and workshops that turn insight into tangible business outcomes.
* Work closely with the Tracking Insight Manager and TNPS Expert to maximise the impact, adoption and activation of insights across the organisation.
* Bring external best practice, innovation and emerging AI capabilities into Zurich's insight ecosystem to continuously enhance how we generate and apply insight.
Work location is Zurich with travel potentially required up to 10%

s.h: As Senior Insight Manager, you will bring
s.t:
* A passion for understanding customers and translating customer, market and brand data into meaningful business opportunities and actions.
* Strong storytelling and communication skills, with the ability to distil complex information into clear, compelling narratives that influence decision-making.
* Proven experience activating insights within organisations, driving awareness, engagement and action across diverse stakeholder groups.
* Expertise in leading continuous and ad hoc qualitative and quantitative research programmes, either within an in-house insights function or consultancy environment.
* Strong commercial acumen and the ability to connect customer insights with business performance, growth and loyalty outcomes.
* Experience managing complex global programmes and building effective relationships across markets, functions and cultures.
* Demonstrated ability to influence and engage senior stakeholders, facilitating discussions and workshops that drive alignment and action.
* Curiosity and practical experience applying AI and emerging technologies to enhance insight generation, synthesis and activation.
* Strong analytical skills with experience working with large datasets and statistical tools (e.g. Excel, SPSS), turning data into actionable recommendations.
* Experience bringing together multiple data sources to identify performance drivers and generate deeper business understanding.
* A degree (e.g. in business studies, marketing, research, psychology, behavioural science, customer or change management or a related field), alongside significant experience in customer, market or brand insights.
* Knowledge of the insurance sector is beneficial but not essential; curiosity, commercial thinking and a customer-first mindset are critical.
* Fluent English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
**You belong here. **
Imagine working in one of the world-s most sustainable workplaces. At Quai Zurich Campus, you-ll enjoy an environment designed to help you thrive, with benefits that support your well-being and impact, and opportunities to perform at your best, surrounded by top talent and supportive colleagues.
You-ll have access to healthy food options, fitness facilities, and bright, collaborative spaces that spark creativity. Located in the heart of Zurich on the shores of Lake Zurich, the campus offers excellent public transportation links, making your commute simple.
Grow with us through access to learning resources, on-the-job development, and continuous empowerment and support. Be part of a team that is creating a brighter future together.

Zurich is a leading multi-line insurer, serving over 82 million customers in more than 200 countries and territories with more than 65,000 employees.
For over 150 years, Zurich has been transforming insurance - offering not just protection, but also prevention services that promote well-being and climate resilience.
Guided by our purpose to -create a brighter future together,- we aim to be one of the most responsible and impactful businesses in the world.
We look forward to receiving your online application today!

At Zurich, we like to think outside the box and challenge the status quo. We take an optimistic approach by focusing on the positives and constantly asking What can go right?

Workplace: Genève | Sector : Private Banking | Function: Relationship Manager - Private Banking
Nous sommes un partenaire privilégié des moyennes et grandes entreprises, entrepreneurs et clients privés fortunés.

Nous proposons des solutions adaptées de financement, de placement et d-épargne à notre clientèle, en partenariat avec les services du groupe Crédit Mutuel Alliance Fédérale, dans un esprit de soutien à l-économie suisse et ses acteurs. Notre établissement financier emploie plus de 480 collaboratrices et collaborateurs sur huit sites en Suisse.

Outre notre siège principal à Bâle, nous possédons des succursales à Fribourg, Genève, Lausanne, Lugano, Neuchâtel, Sion et Zurich.
Et si nous écrivions ensemble la prochaine étape de votre carrière ?
## **Votre Mission** ##
* Conseiller nos clients de manière globale et orientée vers leurs besoins, les aider à optimiser leur situation financière et leur recommander activement les produits et services bancaires correspondants.
* Solliciter et collaborer avec les services internes (juridique, fiscal, compliance, crédit, expert en investissement, etc.) et/ou externes en fonction des besoins du client afin de définir une stratégie de placement et d'offrir des solutions d-investissement, de financement et de structuration patrimoniale adaptées aux besoins du client et dans le respect de la politique commerciale de la Banque.
* Entretenir et assurer le suivi de la relation commerciale, à travers des contacts réguliers avec les clients (téléphone, visites, événements, etc.) afin de les tenir informés de l'évolution de leur patrimoine, de l'actualité financière et fiscale, de les fidéliser dans le but de les accompagner tout au long de leur vie et ainsi créer des opportunités de développement et de pérenniser la relation.
* Assurer la conformité et la documentation de la relation client (KYC, AML, MIFID, etc.), des transactions (KYT) en adéquation avec les procédures de la Banque afin de respecter la réglementation et de préserver la bonne réputation de la Banque.
* Développer le fonds de commerce existant, identifier les opportunités d'entrée en relation et de développement du fonds de commerce afin d'acquérir de nouveaux clients et prendre en charge les prospects qui se présentent à la Banque afin d-établir une relation commerciale
* Vous encouragez la collaboration au sein de la banque en développant et en transférant vos clients vers d'autres segments et en faisant appel à des spécialistes.
* Se tenir informé de l-actualité (économique, fiscale, etc.) et des réglementations afin de disposer des connaissances adéquates pour répondre aux besoins des clients et les conseiller de façon pertinente.
## **Votre Profil** ##
Au bénéfice d'une solide formation bancaire (université, école supérieure ou CFC) complété idéalement par une certification SAQ CWMA, vous justifiez d-une expérience confirmée dans la gestion de fortune et êtes à même d-identifier et prospecter de nouveaux clients par votre esprit entrepreneurial et votre connaissance du tissu socio-économique genevois.

Vous disposez d-une grande aisance relationnelle, de capacités de négociation, d-un bon esprit d-initiative et d-un sens des responsabilités développé. Vous êtes une personne positive et communicative qui accorde beaucoup d'importance au travail en équipe.

De langue maternelle française, vous disposez également de très bonnes connaissances d-anglais (B2).
## **Notre Offre** ##
Rejoindre CIC (Suisse), c-est évoluer dans un environnement dynamique et entrepreneurial où le développement des compétences est au cœur de nos valeurs. Grâce à une structure à taille humaine, nous cultivons proximité, réactivité et autonomie, avec des circuits de décision courts. Ici, chacun peut innover, oser et exprimer pleinement son potentiel.

Que vous soyez en début de carrière ou expert du secteur bancaire, vous évoluerez dans un cadre de travail attractif où le talent fait la différence et où de véritables opportunités de développement permettent de participer activement à la croissance de la banque.
Date d'entrée : immédiate ou à convenir.
